promptZh: 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，根据每个空格给出的中文提示，在空格处填入恰当的单词或短语（同义表达均可）。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文记叙班级马拉松接力赛中“我”从落后到反超的经历，展现坚持与集体荣誉感。
explanation.ruleZh: 完形填空要抓住叙事线与情感线，动作链（出发—交棒—反超—完赛）中的动词是命题重点。

evidence.quote: On the day of the race, the weather was perfect.
I was overtaken by a runner from Class Six.

segments.text: Last term, our class entered the city's marathon relay. Each of
had to complete four kilometres. I had never run

far in my life, so I trained every evening around the playground.

On the day of the race, the weather was perfect. Our first runner set off
a shot, and the crowd cheered loudly. When the baton finally
my hand, my legs felt like jelly. I told

to start slowly and save some strength for the last kilometre.

Halfway through my leg, I was overtaken by a runner from Class Six. Instead of
up, I fixed my eyes on her back and kept my steps steady. Little
little, I caught up with her just before the exchange zone. The whole class was

when I passed the baton on in second place.

We ended the race third,
everyone agreed it felt like a victory. On the bus home, we made a
: next year, we would come back for the gold medal.

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.clue: 介词 of 后的人称代词（我们）
gaps.explanationZh: Each of us 表示我们中的每一个人，of 为介词后接宾格。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.explanationZh: never run that far 表示从未跑过那么远，that 为指示副词，so 亦可。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.explanationZh: set off like a shot 表示像离弦之箭一样冲出去。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.explanationZh: 接力棒最终到达我手中，reach 为及物动词直接接宾语。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.explanationZh: 主语是 I，告诫自己用 told myself。

gaps.label: 第6空
gaps.clue: instead of 后接动名词（放弃）
gaps.explanationZh: Instead of 为介词短语后接动名词，give up 表示放弃。

gaps.label: 第7空
gaps.clue: 固定短语 little by little
gaps.explanationZh: little by little 为固定短语，表示一点一点地。

gaps.label: 第8空
gaps.explanationZh: 交接棒时全班为我欢呼，was cheering/shouting 或 was excited 均可。

gaps.label: 第9空
gaps.explanationZh: 只获第三名与感觉像胜利之间是转折关系。

gaps.label: 第10空
gaps.explanationZh: make a promise 表示许下承诺，与明年来夺金的决心呼应。
